title: Stage 2 Part B.3 Hydrological Metadata Readiness Gate

status_values.CONFIRMED: Supported by authoritative, traceable evidence applicable to the exact dataset/resource and relevant station or observation.
status_values.UNRESOLVED: Evidence is missing, insufficient, ambiguous, not authoritative, or not demonstrably applicable to the exact input.
status_values.NOT_APPLICABLE: The field or requirement does not apply, with a specific documented justification and reviewer evidence.

evidence_rules: A CSV header, value, filename, plausible range, collector configuration, or consistency between fields is not by itself authoritative confirmation.
Evidence must identify the issuer, document/resource/version, retrieval or effective date, scope, and affected dataset/stations.
A blank or sentinel value must not be reinterpreted without an authoritative data dictionary.
Do not convert timestamps or levels, merge station identities, choose among revisions, impute gaps, or remove records while a required gate is unresolved.

blocking_requirements: Exact source provenance and export completeness
Authoritative stable station IDs and complete station crosswalk
Coordinate CRS, source, accuracy, station-location history
Water-level quantity, units, sign convention, negative/sentinel semantics
Definitions of RL_of_zeroGauge and MeanSeaLevel and compatible vertical datum
Station operating periods, expected cadence, and missing-observation semantics
Applicable license, attribution requirements, and permitted reuse
unblock_evidence: Written provider response or official, versioned data dictionary/resource documentation covering the exact source exports
Authoritative station registry crosswalk mapping every source identity to stable gauge ID and effective-dated station/location metadata
Explicit timestamp field semantics and timezone, applicable to both files
Documented units, sign/sentinel semantics, field definitions, vertical datum and any conversion rules
QC flag dictionary or explicit confirmation of no source QC flags, with a supported safe unresolved/suspect mapping policy
Written duplicate/revision handling rule and traceable source row/revision identifiers
Station schedules and coverage/outage semantics adequate to describe gaps without treating missing data as non-events
Exact resource provenance/completeness and integrity evidence for the local CSVs
Applicable license or written permission covering intended local processing, derivative creation, research use, publication, and redistribution as applicable
Documented human review of evidence and a per-station sign-off before generating a derivative

Authoritative stable ID for each of the 66 audit identities, including name/code/coordinate mapping, renaming/reuse/movement history and effective dates.
Coordinate order, CRS/datum, survey/source, accuracy, represented physical feature, and effective-dated moves for each station.
Authoritative code/name reference and version/effective dates applicable to each station.
Provider-confirmed basin, river, tributary/reach and station context; file metadata and filename agreement alone are insufficient.
Definition of measurement versus receipt/ingestion time; source timezone/offset; clock synchronization, precision, daylight-saving and late-correction conventions.
Data dictionary defining the measured quantity, unit, sign, negative/extreme values, sentinel codes and relation to gauge zero.
Definitions, units, benchmark, reference elevation, vertical datum, survey epoch, validity period and conversion equation; explain zero/default values.
Verified gauge-specific datum and evidence of compatibility or valid transformations across stations and reference fields.
QC/status dictionary and validation rules, or explicit provider confirmation that no observation QC flag exists plus an approved treatment policy.
Provider classification of repeats, revision/correction identifiers, authoritative version selection policy and row traceability.
Effective-dated commissioning/retirement/relocation, expected cadence, completeness/outage logs and the meaning of absent timestamps.
Definition and station/time scope; confirmation whether this field is unrelated to water-level quality.
Exact license/version or written permission covering retention, processing, derivative creation, research, publication, redistribution and commercial use as applicable.
Provider confirmation for this exact historical resource. The header/catalog declaration of metres is not independently verified evidence.

normalization_evidence_required_common: Verified exact file/resource linkage and source completeness.
Authoritative station crosswalk covering every row and every effective-dated station identity/location.
Confirmed Data Acquisition Time semantics and timezone for each input.
Confirmed water-level unit, quantity, sign/sentinel rules, and compatible gauge vertical datum/reference conversion semantics.
Provider QC or status semantics and documented handling for missing/suspect measurements.
Provider rule for repeated station/timestamp records and revisions, preserving all source rows and provenance.
Explicit missing-observation and station operating-period semantics; no interpolation.
Applicable license/permission and attribution terms permitting the intended normalization and downstream use.
Human reviewer approval and recorded evidence references for every CONFIRMED field; all blocking fields in both datasets must be CONFIRMED before normalization.

field_review_policy.confirmation_rule: Set a field to CONFIRMED only after an authorized reviewer establishes that authoritative evidence applies to the exact dataset, stations, and relevant time period, and records the evidence source, scope, decision, reviewer, and date on that field.
field_review_policy.normalization_rule: Normalization remains BLOCKED for both datasets while any required field is UNRESOLVED or lacks accepted field-level traceability.
